purpose: External append-only usage telemetry for Graph Companion investigations and bounded value review
dag_rules: Parent references are event_id values and are canonicalized deterministically.
Finalization does not invent a parent; unresolved parents remain explicit in the event and receipt.
Known parents compile before children; event_id ascending is the deterministic tie-breaker.
Cycles are reported as BLOCKED_CYCLE and never silently treated as a valid order.
invariants: A duplicate event_id with a different immutable hash is DUPLICATE_CONFLICT.
An identical event_id and hash is idempotently REUSED without overwriting an artifact.
Equal, nested, symlinked, and reparse-point roots are rejected when they resolve to the Product repository.
Telemetry events are evidence context and cannot write Product Truth, SettlementResult, score, rank, or a formal writer.
